description: Source code for the CalculatorProgrammerBitFlipPanel class, a UI control for bit flipping in a calculator app, handling property changes, button assignments, and automation updates.

classes.name: CalculatorProgrammerBitFlipPanel
classes.description: A sealed partial class representing a UI panel for bit flipping in programmer mode, managing bit toggle buttons, property change subscriptions, and automation properties.

methods.name: CalculatorProgrammerBitFlipPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bit flip panel, setting up button references.

methods.name: ShouldEnableBit
methods.description: Determines if a specific bit index should be enabled based on bit length.

methods.name: OnLoaded
methods.description: Event handler for control load, subscribes to property changes.

methods.name: OnUnloaded
methods.description: Event handler for control unload, unsubscribes from property changes.

methods.name: SubscribePropertyChanged
methods.description: Subscribes to the ViewModel's property changed events and updates UI state.

methods.name: OnPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles ViewModel property changes, updating UI and automation properties accordingly.

methods.name: AssignFlipButtons
methods.description: Assigns UI button controls to internal array for bit toggling.

methods.name: OnBitToggled
methods.description: Handles user toggling a bit button, updates model and automation properties if in programmer mode.

methods.name: GenerateAutomationPropertiesName
methods.description: Generates descriptive automation name for a bit position and value.

methods.name: UpdateCheckedStates
methods.description: Updates the checked state of all flip buttons based on the model's binary digits.

methods.name: UpdateAutomationPropertiesNames
methods.description: Updates automation property names for all flip buttons.

methods.name: GetIndexOfLastBit
methods.description: Returns the highest index for a given bit length.
